students.name: Aiman Hakim bin Roslan
students.thesis_title: Deep Learning-Based Anomaly Detection for Offshore Pipeline Sensor Data
students.abstract: This study develops an LSTM autoencoder model to detect anomalies in multivariate time series collected from offshore pipeline sensors, comparing it with isolation forest and one-class SVM baselines on field data from a Malaysian operator.
students.keywords: deep learning; anomaly detection; time series; sensor data; pipelines
students.stage: Not started: use for the full live walkthrough (eligibility to viva)
students.demo_points: Matcher should rank Farah Liyana Rosli and Melissa Teoh highly; Priya Ramasamy flagged for co-authorship with the supervisor

students.name: Nurin Batrisyia binti Azlan
students.thesis_title: Nanoparticle-Assisted Enhanced Oil Recovery in Carbonate Reservoirs
students.abstract: The thesis investigates silica and alumina nanoparticles for wettability alteration and incremental oil recovery in carbonate cores under reservoir conditions.
students.keywords: enhanced oil recovery; nanoparticles; carbonate reservoirs; wettability alteration
students.stage: Notice submitted, waiting for AE acknowledgement
students.demo_points: AE acknowledges; Azman Yahya (external at UTP) should be flagged if picked

students.abstract: Mixed matrix membranes with metal-organic framework fillers are fabricated and tested for CO2/CH4 separation performance and plasticisation resistance.
students.keywords: membrane separation; mixed matrix membranes; co2 capture; natural gas

students.thesis_title: Machine Learning Prediction of Concrete Compressive Strength with Industrial By-Products

students.keywords: concrete; compressive strength; machine learning; industrial by-products; fly ash

students.thesis_title: Job Autonomy, Work Passion and Innovative Work Behaviour in Malaysian R&D Organisations
students.abstract: A quantitative survey of 300 R&D employees analysed with PLS-SEM examines the effects of job autonomy and work passion on innovative work behaviour, moderated by communication climate.
students.keywords: job autonomy; work passion; innovative work behaviour; communication climate; pls-sem
